{
  "dataset_name": "postcutoff_salmonella_serovar_20260401",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "blue_green_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of the blue-green band to the green peak band, capturing relative pigment variations.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a normalized contrast feature that helps linear SVMs separate samples based on relative color absorption rather than absolute intensity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "Band_48_W_493.10 / (Band_79_W_555.00 + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "red_edge_slope",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between two bands in the red-edge region, indicating the steepness of the reflectance drop-off.",
      "value_range": [-1000.0, 3000.0],
      "feature_family": "linear_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the derivative of the spectrum in a critical region, providing a strong linear margin for SVMs.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "Band_140_W_676.40 - Band_150_W_696.60"
    },
    {
      "name": "nir_intensity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average intensity across three near-infrared bands.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 400.0],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooths out noise in the NIR region, providing a stable continuous measure of overall NIR reflectance.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(Band_280_W_955.40 + Band_290_W_975.20 + Band_299_W_993.20) / 3.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "overall_brightness",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average intensity across four widely spaced bands representing different spectral regions.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4000.0],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Acts as a baseline normalization factor, allowing the SVM to account for overall illumination or sample thickness differences.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(Band_20_W_437.20 + Band_79_W_555.00 + Band_130_W_656.60 + Band_280_W_955.40) / 4.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "spectral_contrast",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between the maximum of the visible peaks and the minimum of the absorption valleys.",
      "value_range": [-1000.0, 7000.0],
      "feature_family": "linear_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a measure of dynamic range within the spectrum, useful for defining margin boundaries in SVMs.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(Band_79_W_555.00, Band_130_W_656.60) - np.minimum(Band_20_W_437.20, Band_280_W_955.40)"
    },
    {
      "name": "uv_violet_absorption",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of the first UV/violet band to a slightly longer wavelength violet band.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 60.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights specific short-wavelength absorption characteristics, offering a normalized feature robust to overall brightness.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "Band_2_W_401.00 / (Band_20_W_437.20 + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "yellow_red_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of a yellow band to a red band.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 100.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the relative slope between the yellow and red regions, providing a smooth continuous feature for linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "Band_90_W_576.90 / (Band_130_W_656.60 + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "peak_green_prominence",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of the green peak to the sum of its surrounding shoulder bands.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Quantifies the sharpness of the green peak, which can be a distinguishing structural feature for the linear model.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "Band_79_W_555.00 / (Band_60_W_517.00 + Band_100_W_596.90 + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "nir_variability",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute difference between two near-infrared bands.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 500.0],
      "feature_family": "linear_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Measures the local variance or slope in the NIR region, providing a continuous severity measure of NIR scattering.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(Band_299_W_993.20 - Band_280_W_955.40)"
    },
    {
      "name": "water_absorption_proxy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of two bands near a minor water absorption feature in the NIR.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 150.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a normalized index that may correlate with moisture content, useful as an independent linear predictor.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "Band_260_W_915.50 / (Band_250_W_896.00 + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "semantic_spectral_shape",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of the overall spectral shape, scoring from 0.0 (flat/noisy) to 1.0 (smooth with distinct peaks).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures holistic structural patterns that are difficult to express with simple band math, providing a high-level linear feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "semantic_noise_level",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic estimation of the high-frequency noise or scattering artifacts present in the spectrum, scored from 0.0 (clean) to 10.0 (highly noisy).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the SVM to downweight or adjust margins for noisy samples by providing an explicit continuous noise severity measure.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
